ThingDef.label: lopehorn
ThingDef.description: A light alien grazer that bounds across open plains in small herds, its curled horns used only for show.

ThingDef.label: mossback
ThingDef.description: A small, calm grazer whose back grows a thin film of symbiotic moss.

ThingDef.label: titanhide
ThingDef.description: A colossal alien grazer with layered hide. Peaceful until hurt, then terrifying.

ThingDef.label: dunewalker
ThingDef.description: An enormous wanderer that crosses whole continents eating anything green.

ThingDef.label: shadecat
ThingDef.description: A solitary alien ambush hunter with light-drinking fur.

ThingDef.label: ridgeclaw
ThingDef.description: A heavy predator with a crest of bony plates and long hooked claws.

ThingDef.label: howlback
ThingDef.description: An alien pack hunter that coordinates attacks with eerie, rising howls.

ThingDef.label: glassfang
ThingDef.description: A small pack predator with translucent, razor-sharp teeth.

ThingDef.label: skyfin
ThingDef.description: A gliding creature that rides warm air currents on broad skin fins. Lays eggs.

ThingDef.label: duskwing
ThingDef.description: A small flyer that hunts insects at dusk. Lays eggs.

ThingDef.label: shellback
ThingDef.description: A slow crawler covered in thick carapace plates that can be worked like armor.

ThingDef.label: plated crawler
ThingDef.description: A low, plated crawler that rolls into a ball when threatened.

ThingDef.label: hivemite
ThingDef.description: A colony insect that builds mounds of hardened resin and swarms intruders.

ThingDef.label: silkling
ThingDef.description: A colony insect that spins fine silk to line its nests.
